name: Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer
summary: Allows Titanium client applications to access CoreMotion's Accelerometer APIs.

methods.name: getAccelerometerData
methods.summary: Returns the latest sample of accelerometer data.
methods.description:
An app that is receiving accelerometer data after calling 
[Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer.startAccelerometerUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer#startAccelerometerUpdates) with no callback, needs to periodically
check the value returned by this method and process the acceleration data.

methods.name: isAccelerometerActive
methods.summary: Returns a Boolean indicating whether accelerometer updates are currently happening.
methods.description:
Indicates whether [Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer.startAccelerometerUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer#startAccelerometerUpdates) has been called since 
[Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer.stopAccelerometerUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer#stopAccelerometerUpdates).

methods.name: isAccelerometerAvailable
methods.summary: Returns a Boolean indicating whether an accelerometer is available on the device.

methods.name: setAccelerometerUpdateInterval
methods.summary: The interval in milliseconds, for providing accelerometer updates to the callback.

methods.name: startAccelerometerUpdates
methods.description:
If a callback is passed to this method, it will be called whenever there is an update.
The frequency of these updates can be controlled using the 
[Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer.setAccelerometerUpdateInterval](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer#setAccelerometerUpdateInterval) method.
If no callback is passed, the accelerometer data can be accessed using the 
[Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer.getAccelerometerData](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer#getAccelerometerData) method. To stop the delivery of events, 
call the [Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer.stopAccelerometerUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer#stopAccelerometerUpdates) method.
Note: It is recommended to set an update interval of at least 250ms before, to avoid receiving
too many callbacks at once.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: The method to be called when there is an update.

inlined.name: CoreMotionAccelerometerDataWithSuccess
inlined.summary: Dictionary passed to the callback of the [Accelerometer.startAccelerometerUpdates()](api:Modules.CoreMotion.Accelerometer#startAccelerometerUpdates) method.

properties.name: code
properties.summary: An error code describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: An error message describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: success
properties.summary: A Boolean indicating if the operation was successful or not.
